name: Importing a spreadsheet
summary: Let somebody upload a CSV, match up their column names to yours, and tell them exactly which rows are wrong.

provenance.changes: Written for the Shipyard starter stack.

postInstall: Describe your columns once, then show the mapping screen so people can match theirs to yours.
Show every bad row at once. Rejecting a 900-row file for one mistake, repeatedly, is how people give up.
limitations: CSV and tab-separated files. Not .xlsx — a spreadsheet has formulas, several sheets and merged cells, and reading one properly is a different job.
It checks the shape of each value, not whether it is true. It cannot tell you the email address belongs to a real person.
Everything is held in memory, so very large files (hundreds of thousands of rows) need a different approach.
solves: let people upload a spreadsheet of data
bulk import records from a csv file
import a list of customers or products
upload a csv and check it for mistakes
